art_direction.style: Original premium editorial photography for Collect, depicting fictional contemporary Rwandan people and settings. Show everyday competence, cooperation and dignity, with natural skin texture, believable anatomy, practical objects and restrained colour. Use a 35–50 mm documentary lens feel at eye level; avoid glossy corporate-stock posing. The described location is creative setting direction, not evidence of a real event or person's origin.
art_direction.composition: Generate one image, portrait 3:4, ideally 1536 x 2048 pixels; record the actual output dimensions. Keep the story-critical faces and object cluster within the central 60% of width and the middle 45% of height. Leave the upper 15% and lower 25% visually quiet for Collect's category and title overlays. All essential content must remain understandable in the tall 358:438 card, square/circle avatar and central 3:2 preview crops. Do not bake in a UI, text, vignette or gradient.
art_direction.constraints: All depicted people are fictional adults, with no real customer likeness, testimonial or identifiable institution. Use contemporary everyday clothing except the occasion-specific dress explicitly requested. Keep phones and notebooks unreadable; avoid cash piles, readable currency, payment confirmations, bank cards, logos, watermarks, text, official flags and political insignia. No safari shorthand, generic pan-African costume, humiliating poverty imagery, medical distress or graphic death. No collage, multiple scenes, border or app screenshot. This is original illustrative photography, not evidence that money has been received, a loan granted, insurance activated or a partnership established.

selection_policy.scope: Creator-selected group type, optional image theme and explicit library search, evaluated locally
selection_policy.context_activation: Explicitly selecting a named theme activates its context. Existing Church type also activates Christian context. No inference from name, face, phone, country, contacts, contribution history or free-form group description.
selection_policy.browse_all: Shows neutral themes by default and named sensitive-theme entry points; only opens sensitive artwork on explicit context selection. Available does not mean preselected.
selection_policy.ranking: Context eligibility first. In suggested mode match current type, then selected theme (+100), type (+50), declared subtype (+20), exact query-token matches (+5 each) and editorial priority (+0..9). Query tokens are ANDed; a no-match returns an empty state. Manual all-library browsing drops the type restriction and type boost, but preserves context eligibility. Stable asset id breaks ties.
selection_policy.general_defaults: Only non-sensitive general_default assets may be used as presentation fallbacks; uploaded/saved user media retains priority. Never write a default to group data merely because it rendered.
selection_policy.privacy: Do not record raw searches or infer a member's religion, health or bereavement. No images, personal data or group text are sent to a recommender service.
selection_policy.named_groups: Named covers are excluded from generic suggestions/defaults. Explicit platform assignment by the authoritative named-group identity is required; do not infer from a user-entered group name.

prompt_spec.scene: Candid preparations for a lively Rwandan wedding in a green Kigali courtyard. Four adult relatives of different ages sit and stand closely around a small table, laughing mid-conversation while a wedding committee organiser checks an unmarked notebook and an older aunt holds fresh flowers. Wear elegant everyday celebration-preparation clothes in vibrant coral, teal and blue. A softly blurred white wedding canopy, greenery and a few other adults create a lived-in event atmosphere. Capture natural gestures, one person interrupting with a joke, believable eye contact and practical shared planning rather than a posed photograph. Keep all four complete heads and the small table together near the middle of the portrait.
prompt_spec.materials_and_details: Natural contemporary Rwandan wedding details, believable cloth folds, actual-looking family interaction and unbranded objects. Umushanana must read as a long flowing skirt with one-shoulder draping over a fitted blouse where described. No theatrical pan-African costume, stiff editorial line-up or identical generated faces. No logos, readable text or financial information.
prompt_spec.lighting_and_palette: Vibrant but believable colour: rich coral, emerald, turquoise, royal blue, clean ivory and fresh green foliage. Bright natural Rwandan daylight, accurate dark skin tones and lively event atmosphere. Avoid muted brown or beige grading.
